args.title: Fix the busy state not resetting on export failure
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component sets 'busy' to true when export starts but only resets it on successful export completion. Change it to reset 'busy' also if exportReport throws, so the button is not left greyed out and disabled after a failed export.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component sets its busy state to true only when export starts and resets it only on successful export. If exporting fails and throws an error, the busy state is never reset, causing the export button to remain disabled until the page is reloaded.
